Markets.title: Lower crude, global stability to drive market growth in new Samvat: ANMI President Kamlesh Shroff
Markets.summary: India's macroeconomic environment is projected to grow by over seven percent, supporting equity markets during the new Samvat. Falling crude oil prices and reduced geopolitical tensions are expected to attract foreign investors and strengthen the rupee.

Markets.summary: The NSE CEO reports that India's economy is growing faster due to strong macroeconomic fundamentals and effective management of fiscal pressures. Additionally, domestic financial savings have reached USD 1.4 trillion annually while foreign capital is returning to the markets.

Markets.summary: During the special Muhurat trading session, the Sensex rose by 320 points and the Nifty crossed the 25,100 mark. Tata Steel and Sun Pharma were among the top gaining stocks during the market event.

Geo-Political.summary: Israel's recent election ended without either Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc or his rival securing a parliamentary majority. Following this deadlock, the Israeli president has tasked opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot with forming a new government.

Geo-Political.summary: The United States is offering a $20 million reward for information regarding Iran's nuclear program. This comes as Donald Trump repeatedly raises the possibility of renewing military strikes against Iranian nuclear facilities.

Geo-Political.summary: Former Brexit negotiator Michel Barnier stated that European Union nations will reject any British attempts to selectively adopt single market rules. He emphasized that the UK cannot cherry-pick components of an economic deal with the EU.

Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves dropped by $2.69 billion to $717.06 billion in the week ending October 30, driven by central bank dollar sales and asset valuation changes. This decline reflects the Reserve Bank of India's efforts to manage currency fluctuations and stabilize the rupee.

Data & Insights.title: Iran war: IOC to buy crude, LPG carriers as Strait of Hormuz disruptions drive freight costs
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Oil Corporation plans to purchase crude and LPG carriers and explore domestic shipbuilding to counter rising freight costs caused by Strait of Hormuz disruptions. This initiative supports the company's broader strategy to diversify crude supplies, build inventories, and strengthen its energy supply chain.

Data & Insights.title: The midterms give Fed more room to raise rates, mut maybe less reason to do so
Data & Insights.summary: Midterm election results suggest a slowdown in datacenter spending. This reduction in spending could help curb inflation and influence Federal Reserve interest rate decisions.

Data & Insights.title: No fresh curbs on broken rice exports as India banks on steady paddy procurement
Data & Insights.summary: India, the world's largest rice exporter, shipped 8.08 lakh tonnes of broken rice in calendar year 2025 after lifting a previous export ban on March 7, 2025. The government is not planning any fresh restrictions on broken rice exports because of steady paddy procurement.

Data & Insights.title: Bond yield rise squeezes banks' Q2 treasury gains
Data & Insights.summary: Rising bond yields caused public and private banks to report losses on their treasury income during the second quarter. This elevated yield environment may continue to pressure bank earnings through the December quarter.

Data & Insights.title: Internship scheme's new pilot gets more takers post rejig
Data & Insights.summary: About 40,000 candidates have joined the third pilot round of the PM Internship Scheme, which is 2.5 times the turnout of the first two rounds combined. This strong response has prompted the corporate affairs ministry to consider launching the full program next year without additional pilots.

India.title: Primary Education Key To Social Transformation, Says Odisha Chief Minister

India.title: Railway Junior Engineer Answer Key 2026 Soon: Know How To Download, Next Process
India.summary: The Railway Recruitment Board will soon release the CBT 1 answer key for the 2026 Junior Engineer examination. Candidates can download the answer key from the official website by entering their registration number and password.

India.title: Naxals Wiped Out In Forests But 'Dimagi Naxals Hide Among Us': PM Modi In Bastar On Diwali
India.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated in Bastar that while Maoists have been eliminated from the forests, "dimagi Naxals" or ideological sympathizers still remain hidden among the public. He made this remark while referencing recent agitations allegedly backed by elements seeking to create chaos.
